lines.text: Habakkuk the prophet receives a vision and cries "Violence!" to the LORD, who does not save.
Habakkuk says the law is paralyzed because the wicked hem in the righteous, so justice is perverted.
The LORD says He is raising up the Philistines, a ruthless nation that marches through the earth to seize dwellings.
The Chaldeans are dreaded and feared, and their horses are swifter than bears and fiercer than wolves of the night.
The Chaldeans come bent on violence, laugh at every fortress, and their own strength is their god.
